scripts.postinstall: npm run build -w @riftroom/shared && npm run db:generate -w @riftroom/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @riftroom/shared && npm run build -w @riftroom/api && npm run build -w @riftroom/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @riftroom/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @riftroom/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
